falsifiable_hypothesis: The verified common standard-control calibrator uses one scalar correction shared by all targets. After removing that common component and the prior-damped plate-imbalance interaction with fitting-only cross-fitting, the remaining 24-target residual may contain one shared assay-quality direction whose target amplitudes differ. A rank-1 reduced-rank control map tests exactly one such direction while avoiding the 72-parameter targetwise control fit that previously regressed.
upstream_rule: Reproduce standard_control_meanquad_plate_interaction_v2 exactly from the same two_dose_full_negative_A_extension base, including global mean/std/min/max paid calibration, min/max cardinality contrast, shared/two-dose/three-dose local pooling, [mean_range,half_plate_difference,mean_range_squared] common control ridge, and PRIOR-damped target plate interaction.
rank1_training_rule: Within each outer-training partition, first construct the twice-cross-fitted upstream residual matrix. Cross-fit the common control model across the fixed K=3 inner whole-patient folds, subtract it, then cross-fit the prior-damped plate-interaction model and subtract PRIOR times its held-fold prediction. On that post-interaction matrix fit a multioutput ridge from the same centered three-column control basis. Ridge lambda equals PRIOR times the mean patient-weighted control-feature energy. Take the exact rank-1 SVD truncation of the resulting 3x24 coefficient matrix.
deployment_rule: Fit the rank-1 map on all outer-training post-interaction residuals and add exactly 1/K of its prediction to orientation B, where K=3 is the frozen number of inner whole-patient folds. Orientation A remains unchanged. No rank menu, strength menu, target routing, fold rescue, clipping, or protected data is used.
budget_statement: Adds zero treatment wells, keeps the 64 treatment wells and 32/32 plate split unchanged, and uses only the same declared DMSO/BzCl standard controls required by the comparator.

task_contract.ab_rule: average losses across separately costed A/B orientations; never average predictions
